text.tspan: If you use the battery option, do not use CH04/GPIO5.
3. CH02 (GPIO pin 15) - Wired as a relay. GPIO configurable as a relay, servo or ambient light (or sensor)
4. CH03 (GPIO pin 16) - Configurable as a relay, servo, sensor or ambient light.
5. CH05 (GPIO pin 6) - Configurable as a relay, servo, sensor or ambient light.
6. CH06 (GPIO pin 7) - Configurable as a relay, servo, sensor or ambient light.
USB-Out: CH01 (GPIO pin 14) - Wired as a relay. GPIO configurable as a relay or servo.
Not connected (NC): CH04 (GPIO pin 5) - Configurable as a relay, servo, ambient light or battery sensor.
Option 1: The relay for Channel 2 can optionally be powered by the wide-range input voltage.
To do this, an internal jumper must be installed.
Note: The UNI (Universal) version differs from the FOUR version only in the wiring.
